panels.title: Retention cohort: Day 0-7
panels.description: Cohort = first VIEW_STARTED (UTC). Return = any event. Future days are null. Today is provisional.

targets.rawSql: SELECT metric_date AS Cohort, maxIf(value,dimension='0') AS `Day 0`, maxIf(value,dimension='1') AS `Day 1`, maxIf(value,dimension='2') AS `Day 2`, maxIf(value,dimension='3') AS `Day 3`, maxIf(value,dimension='4') AS `Day 4`, maxIf(value,dimension='5') AS `Day 5`, maxIf(value,dimension='6') AS `Day 6`, maxIf(value,dimension='7') AS `Day 7` FROM cinema.metrics_current WHERE metric_name='retention' AND metric_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND metric_date <= toDate($__toTime) GROUP BY metric_date ORDER BY metric_date

SELECT toDateTime(metric_date,'UTC') AS time, value AS DAU FROM cinema.metrics_current WHERE metric_name='dau' AND metric_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND metric_date <= toDate($__toTime) ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(metric_date,'UTC') AS time, value AS Conversion FROM cinema.metrics_current WHERE metric_name='conversion' AND metric_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND metric_date <= toDate($__toTime) ORDER BY time

SELECT dimension AS Movie, sum(value) AS Views FROM cinema.metrics_current WHERE metric_name='movie_views' AND metric_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND metric_date <= toDate($__toTime) GROUP BY Movie ORDER BY Views DESC, Movie LIMIT 10

SELECT toDateTime(metric_date,'UTC') AS time, value AS Seconds FROM cinema.metrics_current WHERE metric_name='average_watch_seconds' AND metric_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND metric_date <= toDate($__toTime) ORDER BY time
